title: Add greet.mjs CLI script with vitest tests

tasks.title: Create scripts/greet.mjs CLI script
tasks.instructions:
Create the file scripts/greet.mjs with a Node.js CLI script that:
1. Reads the first CLI argument via process.argv[2]
2. Defaults to 'world' if no argument provided
3. Prints 'Hello, <name>!' to stdout (with newline)

Example behavior:
- `node scripts/greet.mjs` outputs: Hello, world!
- `node scripts/greet.mjs Alice` outputs: Hello, Alice!

Use a simple 2-3 line implementation with console.log().
tasks.done_when: node scripts/greet.mjs | grep -q 'Hello, world' && node scripts/greet.mjs Bob | grep -q 'Hello, Bob'

tasks.title: Create test/greet.test.ts vitest test
tasks.instructions:
Create test/greet.test.ts with vitest tests that:
1. Import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
2. Import { spawn } from 'node:child_process' to run the script
3. Create a test that runs 'node scripts/greet.mjs' with no arguments and checks output contains 'Hello, world!'
4. Create a test that runs 'node scripts/greet.mjs' with argument 'Alice' and checks output contains 'Hello, Alice!'

Pattern: use spawn or execSync to run the command, capture stdout, and assert with expect().
See test/shell-check.test.ts for examples of running shell commands in vitest.
